title: Salt Lake UTV Off Road Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Utah boasts some of the most stunning and diverse off-road terrain in the country—and now you can experience it firsthand on a private Side-by-Side UTV tour. Whether you're drawn to the wide-open desert or the rugged mountain trails, we’ve got the perfect ride for you.

Tour Options
3-Hour Tour
Our most popular ride. Ideal for those looking for a high-energy adventure with enough time to explore varied terrain and soak in the views—without taking up your whole day.

5-Hour Tour
Want more time on the trail? This extended tour lets us go deeper into the backcountry and visit the historic mining town of Eureka, with extra time for photo stops, scenic overlooks, and rugged fun.

Ride with the guide - an option for those who want the guide to drive them around.

Driver Requirements
Drivers must be 18+ years old with a valid license
No age restriction for passengers

*IF IT SAYS SOLD OUT PLEASE REACH OUT TO US. The availability is sometimes incorrect
